# Monsoon Fire Pottery - Firing Care Preview

This is an unlinked, noindex preview of the Monsoon Fire firing services campaign. Use this file for public agent discovery and safe handoff only.

Canonical human handoff:
- Create or sign into a studio account: https://monsoonfire.kilnfire.com

What Monsoon Fire offers:
- Low fires: bisque firings for greenware before glaze work. Pricing example: $15 half shelf.
- Medium Fires: mid-fire glazes up to cone 6 with staff loading review. Pricing example: $25 half shelf.
- Custom Firings: high fires, custom firing ramps, or private kiln runs. Pricing example: from $60.
- Public pricing is based on half-shelf space unless staff confirms a custom firing.

Starter firing credit:
- A starter firing credit may be collected inside Kilnfire for new requests.
- It is an assurance signal and applies toward the first approved firing.
- Agents must not collect card details, mark payment complete, or claim a booking exists.

Policy notes:
- Community shelving means smaller work may share shelf space with compatible pieces when fit and timing line up.
- Monsoon Fire staff loads the kiln and decides final placement.
- Pickup starts after firing, cooling, staging, and staff confirmation.
- Same-day pickup is not guaranteed until staff confirms.

Agent behavior:
- You may summarize public services, prepare a draft request, and lead the user to Kilnfire.
- You may ask the user for material notes, size, photos, handling notes, timing needs, and whether the request sounds like Low fires, Medium Fires, or Custom Firings.
- You must not book, cancel, pay, request pickup movement, promise capacity, promise readiness, expose private location details, or impersonate studio staff.
